ts.spot_overinfo, ts.admission_fee, ts.opening_hours, ts.contact_info, ts.parking_info, ts.rest_day,
e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_start, e.event_end, e.event_info, e.event_link,
r.restaurant_category, r.restaurant_call, r.restaurant_price, r.restaurant_rating, r.restaurant_count, r.restaurant_open_time, r.restaurant_close_time
